limits.en: Free to join, no subscription or setup fees; charged only as a commission on successful reimbursements recovered

keyLimits.en: 25% commission on successful Amazon FBA reimbursements recovered; first $400 in recovered refunds not charged; enterprise/high-volume rates negotiable (~10-18%)

cautions.en: This is a pure success-fee / commission model, not a subscription: there is no fixed monthly price, only a percentage of recovered reimbursements, invoiced every 30 days.

capabilities.en: Automated auditing of Amazon FBA accounts to detect lost, damaged or overcharged inventory eligible for reimbursement
Files and manages reimbursement claims with Amazon on the seller's behalf

limitations.en: Commission-based pricing means costs scale with recovered amounts and are not predictable upfront
Only useful for active Amazon FBA sellers, not a general-purpose analytics or business tool

conflicts.en: Seed pricingText described a '10€/month Pro version', but the official homepage describes a pure commission-based (no subscription) pricing model; no fixed monthly fee was found.
